title: The Three Rocks of Glory
description: The Lord lays down three foundations of glory within the natural mind, set there by his own appointing and placed at the outer reaches of the soul's worlds, so that the rational has something stable to stand upon as it is being formed. The first is the path of regeneration itself — the Perfect Man, the rational fully come into its stature, set within the complete circuit of the natural with his foot planted from the lowest place upward. The second is the inmost state of light established directly upon what the soul has claimed — the new land of wisdom set down upon the land of darkness, by which death's storehouse is humbled. The third is the great Thought summoned forth — divine truth shining as illumining wisdom, giving the understanding its light. All three come from one great trust and are set in three great places.
